title: Crypto wallet holdings (crypto/holdings.json, schema_version 1)
description: Producer: collectors/crypto_balances.py::collect (HOLDINGS_SCHEMA_VERSION). Consumer: Metron api/services/crypto.py::_read_holdings_s3/for_portfolio (data-collector plan P-07, alpha-engine-config-I10870, D38). Metron makes no chain calls itself — this artifact is the sole coupling. D38 is PAUSED (alpha-engine-config-I10748, 2026-08-07); the contract is built regardless of run cadence, per plan §3 (a surviving consumer, Metron, already reads this key).

as_of_utc.description: UTC timestamp the artifact was written, %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ. Metron's _is_stale() parses this with datetime.fromisoformat after a 'Z' -> '+00:00' substitution.

chain.description: upper-cased chain code, e.g. BTC, ETH

price_usd.description: absent when price_fn failed this cycle (best-effort; balances still publish without it)

value_usd.description: balance * price_usd; present iff price_usd is present
